Since the shorter slide is steeper, people slide at 80 feet/minute, meaning the time it takes to slide the 240 feet can be found by dividing the slide length by the sliding speed, resulting in a sliding time of \boxed{3}. As they slide for \boxed{5} times longer on the longer slide, the difference in their sliding times is \boxed{5 - 3} or \boxed{2}. So, it takes \boxed{2} times longer to ride the biggest waterslide compared to the second biggest waterslide.
